task.instruction: Find a model released on Hugging Face for recipe generation. Retrieve the information of the model, including its name, model size and tensor type.

final_answer:
I found a recipe generation model on Hugging Face: **flax-community/t5-recipe-generation**, also called "Chef Transformer (T5)".

- **Name:** flax-community/t5-recipe-generation
- **Model size:** 0.2B parameters (Safetensors)
- **Tensor type:** F32

The model was trained on the RecipeNLG dataset during the Flax/JAX Community Week. It is a text-generation (text2text) T5 model. It has 77 likes and 415 downloads last month.
